tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed dang / 'dul ba'i brgyud pa lugs gsum gyi dbye ba/ bsgrub lung yi dam gyi lha las blang ba'i lag len rnams bzhugs// dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed brgyud pa na/ ston pa sangs rgyas/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub/ arya de wa/ zla grags/ rigs pa'i khu byug slob pa'i rdo rje/ dze ta ri dgra las rnam rgyal rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ jo bo puṇya shrī/ rje sa skya pa nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du'o// ༈ //rje bla ma'i gsung las/ gangs can ljongs 'dir 'dul ba'i brgyud pa las/ /smad 'dul stod 'dul kha che paṇa chen nas/ /brgyud pa'i brgyud rim rnam pa gsum mo zhes/ /'dul 'dzin mkhas pa'i rna bar gtam du grags/ /dang por dar mas bstan pa snub pa'i rjes/ /g.yo dmar gtsang gi slob bu bla chen las/ /dbus gtsang mi bcu'i lhag bsam rnam dag mthus/ /mdo khams smad nas dar ba'i brgyud pa yin/ /gnyis pa rgya gar dharma pa la'i sras/ /'dul 'dzin mkhas pa pā la rnam gsum las/ /zhang zhung dge slong rgyal ba shes rab kyis/ /mnga' ris stod nas dar ba'i brgyud pa yin/ /gsum pa kha che paṇa chen shāka shrī las/ /sa paṇa rdo rje dpal dang byang dpal sogs/ /'dul ba'i ring lugs skyong ba'i mkhas rnams kyis/ /dbus gtsang mthil nas dar ba'i brgyud pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so// ༈ //bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos bzang po 'ga' zhig bla mar mi 'os pa'i lag nas byung ngam/ mdo sde dang rgyud sde'i don nam/ gzhung ngo mtshar ba mthong nas nyams su blang bar 'dod na/ chos de ma blangs sam/ bla mar mi 'os pa bzung ngam/ rang dgar sgrubs kyang nyes pa gsum dang 'brel bar 'gyur bas thabs 'di yin te/ chos de la lhag par dad pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad la phyag bya ste/ mchod cing sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun bya/

slar yang dkon mchog gi spyan sngar mchod pa rgya chen po bya ste/ bdag sems can thams cad kyi don du dam pa'i chos 'di zhes bya ba/ chos spyod bcus bsgrub par gnas par gsol na/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag la rjes su brtse bas gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyi bar du zhus te/ bla ma sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad yi dam lha'i rnam par byon nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod ci rigs par longs spyod cig ces gnang ba sbyin par bsam zhing nyams su blangs pas bla ma dam pa las thob pa dang khyad med ces/ jo bo yab sras gsungs/ de'i tshe/ dam pa'i chos de dang de lan gsum mam bdun gyi bar du bklags la/ don yid la bya/ sngags yin na de lan bdun du lung 'bogs pa'i tshul gyis bzlas dgos gsung / chos ji ltar bya ba rang gis shes kyang / lung ma nos na byin rlabs mi 'ongs zhing rang dga' ba'i skyon yong / bla ma dam pa rnyed dka' bas sgrub lung yi dam lha las blang ba atha tsha/ zhes pa 'di gtsang nag phug pa brtson 'grus seṅge'i chos tshan brgya rtsa las bshad do/ /tshul 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga'i nyer mkho brjed thor bris pa'o/ /shu bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ /dge bar gyur cig skye dgu rnams la'o// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed dang / 'dul ba'i brgyud pa lugs gsum gyi dbye ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
